item.title: Scientists find how pancreatic cancer alters DNA to evade treatment
item.description: Scientists have discovered how pancreatic cancer cells continually reshape their genetic makeup to become more aggressive, spread, and evade treatment.

item.title: Mysterious mushroom makes people see hundreds of tiny humans
item.description: For nearly a century, people in distant parts of the world have reported a bizarre experience after eating certain wild mushrooms: seeing dozens or even hundreds of tiny humans.
